user.title: Connect to the SYR Local add-on
user.description: Enter the address of the SYR Local add-on's state API. When the add-on runs on this Home Assistant, the defaults usually work.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the add-on, for example local-syr-local.
data_description.port: Port of the add-on's state API (8099 by default).

hassio_confirm.title: SYR Local add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to add {name} (serial {serial}) through the SYR Local add-on? All entities are read-only.

reconfigure.title: Change the add-on address
reconfigure.description: Update the host and port of the SYR Local add-on's state API.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the add-on, for example local-syr-local.
data_description.port: Port of the add-on's state API (8099 by default).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the SYR Local add-on at this address.
error.invalid_response: The address answered, but not with a valid SYR Local state.
error.no_device: The add-on is running but has not identified the water softener yet. Check the DNS redirect and try again in a minute.
error.unsupported_version: The add-on uses a state API version this integration does not support. Update both to the same release.

abort.already_configured: This water softener is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different water softener.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The add-on sent invalid discovery information.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the SYR Local add-on.
abort.invalid_response: The add-on did not return a valid SYR Local state.
abort.no_device: The add-on has not identified the water softener yet.
abort.unsupported_version: The add-on uses a state API version this integration does not support.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the SYR Local add-on.

invalid_response.message: The SYR Local add-on returned an invalid state.

unsupported_version.message: The SYR Local add-on uses an unsupported state API version.

wrong_device.message: The SYR Local add-on is reporting a different water softener.
